blogs.title: Inside Pepper Farm Deli: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Lunch in Santee
blogs.description: Explore Pepper Farm Deli in Santee, CA: Philly Cheesesteak, French Dip, deli sandwiches, breakfast burritos, fresh salads and online ordering.
blogs.html:
Looking for a local deli in Santee with a menu that has something for breakfast, lunch, and everything in between? Pepper Farm Deli brings together hot and cold sandwiches, breakfast favorites, salads, wraps, soups, and more at 235 Town Center Parkway, Suite H. Whether you are planning a quick lunch break, picking up a breakfast burrito on the way to work, or choosing a sandwich for a relaxed meal, our menu offers plenty of flavors and formats to explore.

A neighborhood deli with a menu for every appetite

A good neighborhood deli makes it easy to find a meal that fits your day. At Pepper Farm Deli, you can browse hearty hot sandwiches, classic cold deli sandwiches, fresh salads, wraps, flatbreads, breakfast plates, smoothies, and sides. That variety makes our Santee deli a convenient stop when one person wants a toasted sandwich and someone else is in the mood for a salad or wrap. Check the full Pepper Farm Deli menu to compare current selections and ingredients before you order.

Hot sandwiches made for a satisfying lunch

If you are craving a hot sandwich in Santee, the menu includes familiar favorites with their own distinctive combinations. The Philly Cheesesteak pairs ribeye steak and grilled onions with American white cheddar on a hoagie roll. The French Dip features thinly sliced marinated roast beef, melted Swiss cheese, house-fried onions, and house-made au jus with a toasted hoagie roll. For a different savory option, the OG Reuben layers pastrami, Swiss cheese, and sauerkraut on rye with Dijon and Thousand Island dressing.

There are plenty of other hot deli sandwiches to discover, too. Chicken Pesto brings chicken breast, mozzarella, pesto, arugula, and tomatoes together on ciabatta. The Grilled Chicken Club combines chicken breast with bacon, Havarti, tomatoes, pickles, spring mix, and peppercorn aioli. If you enjoy a warm, substantial sandwich for lunch, browse the hot sandwich section and choose the combination that sounds right to you.

Cold deli sandwiches with classic flavor combinations

Sometimes a freshly made cold sandwich is exactly what lunch calls for. Little Italy layers ham, salami, mortadella, provolone, tomatoes, red onions, pepperoncini, and arugula on a hoagie roll, finished with balsamic and olive oil. Bovine pairs roast beef and Havarti with tomatoes, red onions, pepperoncinis, garlic aioli, and mustard on sourdough. The cold sandwich menu also includes turkey, bacon, roast beef, cheese, vegetables, and house sauces in a range of combinations.

When you are searching for deli sandwiches in Santee, the bread, toppings, and sauces all help shape the meal. Read each menu description to find the ingredients you prefer, then ask our team if you have a question about a specific item or possible customization.

Salads, wraps, soups, and more

A deli lunch can be more than a sandwich. Pepper Farm Deli also serves salads with ingredients such as spinach, arugula, tomatoes, avocado, feta, bacon, and house dressings. Wraps give you another easy-to-carry option, while soups and sides can round out a meal. The broader menu includes flatbreads, burgers, low-carb plates, smoothies, and drinks, so friends, families, and coworkers can each find a different kind of lunch at the same Santee deli.

Menu items and ingredients can change, so use the current online menu for the most accurate descriptions. If you have food allergies or specific dietary needs, contact the deli directly to discuss ingredients and preparation before ordering.

Start the morning with breakfast in Santee

Pepper Farm Deli serves breakfast starting at 8 am. One convenient morning choice is the $7.99 egg-and-cheese Breakfast Burrito, wrapped in a toasted tortilla for an easy breakfast on the go. The breakfast menu also includes sandwiches, wraps, and plates, giving you several ways to start the day near Town Center Parkway. Visit our dedicated Breakfast in Santee page to browse breakfast items, find serving information, get directions, and review online ordering options.

Order lunch or plan food for a group

For an everyday lunch, review the menu and use the online ordering link to see available choices and pickup details. Ordering ahead can make a short lunch break easier to plan. If you are organizing a work lunch, meeting, or family gathering, explore Pepper Farm Deli catering options and contact the team to discuss current selections, portions, timing, and availability. Confirm how many people will eat before choosing food. Ask attendees to respond by a clear deadline, then build in a small buffer for last-minute guests when your budget allows. A final count helps you order the right quantity and avoids running short or creating unnecessary waste.
